title: The Shadow Behind the Throne
intro: You stand within the courts of a mighty ancient kingdom, where a powerful ruler has proclaimed themselves as a god over all the people. Beside this ruler stands a devoted servant, entrusted with the kingdom's grandest ambitions. Together, they plot and plan, refusing to heed the warnings of a messenger sent to guide them. Can you uncover who this loyal servant was?
clues: I lived in a mighty kingdom ruled by a powerful figure who claimed divinity over all the people.
I served as a trusted minister of this ruler, carrying out their every ambition and command.
When a messenger of Allah came to our land calling us to truth, my ruler and I refused to listen.
I was commanded to kindle a great fire and prepare bricks of clay for a grand construction.
My ruler wanted to erect a towering structure so high that it would reach the heavens themselves.
In the end, my ruler, our armies, and I were swept away and drowned in the depths of the sea.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
